deployed_observation.environment: already-running default local Compose project `pantheon` (dev root, up 18h+ at observation time)

first_failure.root_cause: The controller readback response body is now 1,237,625 bytes (257+ accumulated connector configs in the long-lived shared `pantheon` Compose project), while the test harness's _http_json helper reads only response.read(32_768) bytes before json.loads, so the body is truncated mid-object and fails to parse. This is a test-harness fixed-size read cap colliding with a long-lived, ever-growing environment, not a regression in the Loop1 owner/readback fix from PR #4974: source.owner_compose_identity, source.anti_preseed_readback, source.connector_command, source.scheduled_trigger, source.job_trigger, and source.durable_terminal_readback all passed in this rerun, which they did not before PR #4974 merged.
first_failure.secondary_observation: One earlier rerun attempt in this same session failed instead at source.job_trigger with a client-side 15s timeout (server logged the same POST completing successfully with 201 shortly after the client gave up), consistent with the same long-lived environment's accumulated connector/reconcile load pushing single mutating requests close to or past the harness's fixed 15s per-call timeout. This did not reproduce on the immediately following rerun and is recorded here as a related but distinct latency symptom of the same environment-growth condition, not a separate product defect.

cleanup.mutation_note: one connector config plus its schedule and one job/frontier entry were created against the shared default pantheon project by this rerun's e2e run tokens; no repair task, downstream case data, or live-capital action was written

acceptance.statement: Four per-loop cases carry trigger, owner, terminal output, authority readback, and next-consumer identity fields.

The first failure writes one bounded report and does not continue or materialize repair work.

residual_product_gap.description: PR #4974's Loop1 owner-identity/readback fix holds: this rerun passed all six source_ingestion boundaries through source.job_trigger and source.durable_terminal_readback that previously failed at the very first boundary. The chain now stops one boundary later, at source.authority_actual_state, because the harness's fixed 32KB HTTP read cap cannot fit the controller readback payload once the shared long-lived pantheon Compose environment accumulates 257+ connector configs. Loops 2-4 (Distillation, Alpha, Teaching) were still not reached in this rerun, so their readiness beyond Loop1 remains unproven.
residual_product_gap.containment: No product or harness repair is performed by this rerun task per its declared out-of-scope (no automatic repair task created). Re-run the same suite, either after the harness's read cap is raised or run_ingest controller readback is paginated/bounded, or against a freshly reset Compose project with a small connector count, to observe whether loops 2-4 pass.
